changes.addition: **Acquired applicability and stable concern, 6 October 2026:** [the integrated argument and primary comparison](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-INTEGRATION.md) refine the next connection: consequences can require revising an undertaking's application while a wider concern remains stable. The existing sensor-perfect/use-failure case locates an unsupported calibration, distinct from acquired outcome relevance and ethical warrant. A newly incorporated primary comparator supplies bounded empirical support; its design, ordinary alternatives and publication ambiguities are preserved. No controller, simulation, theorem or data reanalysis is added. The missing native join remains acquired failure of applicability → changed requirement or question scope → further inquiry and use in the same supported history.

**When an undertaking remains pertinent, 6 October 2026:** [the connected account](unified-2026-10-05/CONNECTED-GENERATIVE-MODEL.md#learning-an-undertakings-changing-applicability) distinguishes revising a particular undertaking from requiring every ultimate purpose to change. [Source reconstruction, primary comparison and review](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-INTEGRATION.md) separate accurate sensing, calibrated use, acquired outcome relevance and warranted response within their actual histories. The synthesis constrains the missing acquired-applicability connection; it does not install it in the native learner or complete the foundation.

**Applicability and outcome revaluation, 6 October 2026:** [integration](APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-INTEGRATION.md), [source mechanism](APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-MECHANISM.md), [primary comparator](APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-COMPARATOR.md) and [review](APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-REVIEW.md) distinguish changed application under a stable concern from an artificial demand for endless ultimate-purpose revision. Existing sensor/use failures retain their original scopes. The new published-evidence incorporation has bounded identification value, with no new runtime, empirical reanalysis or theorem. The actual native feedback-to-requirement join remains open.

changes.anchor: ## The derivation and the existing work
changes.addition: **Acquired effects → revised applicability, 6 October 2026:** [the integrated continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-INTEGRATION.md) identifies the next relation without requiring every ultimate concern to change: effects alter the relationship making a particular undertaking pertinent, and acquired effects can govern its continued use. Existing code distinguishes sensory correctness from the calibration required for productive use; a focused primary comparison constrains the separate acquired-relevance dependency. Neither supplies ethical authority or the other's mechanism. The next actual join must carry acquired applicability failure into a changed requirement or question scope and further activity, preserving correct prior knowledge, unresolved alternatives and the reached support conditions.

changes.anchor: ## Retained consequence can exceed current evaluative use
changes.addition:
## Learning an undertaking's changing applicability

The [applicability continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes a stable concern from the particular undertaking through which it is pursued. Effects can fulfill, obstruct or change the relation that made an undertaking pertinent. Appropriate persistence remains possible; completion, loss of applicability and loss of capacity are different outcomes. Requiring every ultimate purpose to change would add an unnecessary regress to the governing derivation.

The original acquisition control already learns an exact model of an inverted observation channel while its supplied positive-reading-to-capture interpretation fails. This preserves a real predictive achievement and locates an unsupported use relation. The failed outcome is returned to the surrounding experiment, but this learner does not subsequently acquire it to revise its requirement or inquiry. Later access diagnosis consumes consequence evidence within a different supported history; the two histories cannot be silently spliced.

The [primary comparison](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/APPLICABILITY-REVALUATION-COMPARATOR.md) addresses a separate empirical dependency in acquired outcome relevance. Its detailed scope and alternatives are recorded there. Calibration of an expected effect, the effect's learned influence and its ethical warrant are differentiated relations within generative activity. One does not establish the others, and a fixed encompassing law can describe their genuine acquisition and change.

The next stronger native connection is acquired evidence that the undertaking's application has changed, an operative revision of its requirement or question scope, and actual further inquiry and use. It must preserve accurate prior knowledge, material continuation, ambiguity and independently live claims. The integration adds no favorable score or new controller in place of that explanation.
